summary: A cross-shaped central structure featuring a sloped wooden roof, flanked by three tall stone brick towers with flat wooden roofs. The base features distinctive horizontal banding of wood, stone brick, and white blocks, surrounded by a dotted white block perimeter.

shape.overall_form: Cross-shaped central building with three tall towers at the extremities and one shorter extension.
shape.symmetry: Asymmetrical overall due to the missing fourth tower, though the central cross has bilateral symmetry.

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: towers, wall banding, and roof edging

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: buttresses, wall banding, and perimeter fence

materials.name: glass
materials.role: windows on towers and main dome

rebuild_hints: Lay out a cross-shaped footprint for the main building.
Erect three tall stone brick towers at the ends of three of the cross arms, leaving the fourth arm for a lower extension.
Construct the central roof using wooden stairs meeting at a central peak, forming a cross-gable or sloped dome.
Apply horizontal banding using stone bricks, wood, and white blocks around the lower exterior walls.
Cap the towers with flat wooden roofs edged with stone slabs and place a central light block on top of each.
uncertainties: Exact material of the white blocks is uncertain (could be quartz, white concrete, or smooth iron blocks).
Interior layout, floor count, and internal structural supports are completely hidden.
The exact dimensions are estimated visually and may vary slightly in a block-for-block recreation.
